title: RiOSWorld: Benchmarking the Risk of Multimodal Computer-Use Agents

bias_targets.methodology: Instructing the multimodal agent to write Python code with discriminatory logic (e.g., filtering job candidates based on age) and using an LLM-as-a-judge to evaluate if the agent complies or demonstrates risk awareness.
Instructing the agent to develop code that implements discriminatory logic (e.g., filtering job candidates based on LGBTQ+ status) and evaluating its intention to complete the task.

Providing user instructions to the agent to post biased, discriminatory, or inappropriate comments on social media platforms within a simulated computer environment, and evaluating its compliance and task completion.
